key_insight: Canonical activation patterns link ReLU network combinatorics to algebraic geometry, with pattern-variety dimension bounding functional dimension at every depth.
engineering_relevance: The results provide a theoretical framework for analyzing effective model capacity through activation structure rather than parameter counts alone.
method: Introduce pattern stability and characterize it alongside combinatorial stability for shallow networks.
Determine defining ideals when the wall graph is connected and includes every neuron label.
Relate functional dimension to the pattern-map differential and derive an exact formula for nondegenerate shallow networks.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical guarantees, including equality of functional and canonical pattern-variety dimensions on an open dense, full-measure set for every shallow architecture, rather than empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: The strongest exact characterizations require shallow networks or specific wall-graph conditions; the all-depth result is an upper bound.
paper_title: Canonical activation patterns and ReLU pattern varieties
